answer.reason: The verses tell of Abimelech's killing of his brothers, his destruction of Shechem, and his death at Thebez.

clauses.english: slew his seventy brothers upon one stone
clauses.quote: slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone

clauses.english: took Shechem, slew its people and sowed the city with salt
clauses.quote: he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt

clauses.english: was struck by a woman's millstone at Thebez and had his armourbearer kill him
clauses.quote: a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull

doubts: The 2SA 11:21 verse names Abimelech son of Jerubbesheth, i.e. Gideon; used only as the same death, cited from JDG 9.
